Roles, users and operator presence
Operators focus on production checks. Administrators supervise traceability and validated changes.
OPERATOR
Scan, finalize, restart a NOT OK check and request authorized labels.
ADMIN
Manage users, review controls and make audited corrections.
Presence reflects recent authenticated browser heartbeats
Recent activity = online. Continued heartbeats without recent activity = idle.
Expired or revoked sessions and disabled users are excluded.
GALIA Control · Lear Corporation · Demonstration data
11 / 12
Value before shipment
Expected benefits to validate against the site’s production baseline.
Detect errors at the station
Identify shortages, excess scans and wrong references before the box leaves control.
Support quality decisions
Know who checked the box, which serials were scanned and why a recheck occurred.
Apply consistent rules
Use the same PN, quantity and active serial checks at each operator workstation.
Measure improvement
Track first-pass OK, detected error cases, rechecks and control time during a pilot.
Scan verification supports shipment release. Physical packing checks remain essential.
